correctness.rationale: For each upper-triangular column j of B, AB=0 is exactly A_j b_j=0, where A_j is the leading principal corner, yielding h(A)=sum_j nullity(A_j). Growing A_j by a top-right column v and diagonal a, its nullity jumps iff a=0 and v is in im A_{j-1}; for nullity k previously this has q^{j-1-k} choices and otherwise q^j-q^{j-1-k}. This proves the positive rank-profile formula and recurrence over every finite field. Over an algebraic closure, fixed nullity-jump stratum is iterated a vector-bundle/open-complement construction over the prior irreducible constant-rank stratum, hence geometrically irreducible; B solutions form a vector bundle of rank h_P. Calculating d_P=m-r(r+1)/2+sum_{p in P}(n-p+1), maximized for fixed r by P={1,...,r}, gives m+r(n-r) and exactly one/two top-dimensional closures. Independent enumeration verified Phi and literal AB=0 pairs at small n,q; carefully distinguish dimension proof from polynomial leading term.

value.rationale: This gives the entire distribution of right-annihilator dimensions and all ordered zero-product counts for a natural family of finite noncommutative rings, plus the leading geometric dimension and number of maximal irreducible families in every size. The positive rank-profile statistic and two-index dynamic program are mathematically usable for ring graph/density questions; the geometric component parity is a structural result beyond finite tabulation.
residual_risks: Not a full classification of all components or ring zero-divisor graph degrees; must not overstate scope.

final_claim: For T_n(F_q), the complete right-annihilator dimension enumerator is Phi_{n,q}(T)=sum_{P subset [n]} product_j w_j(P) T^{sum_{p in P}(n-p+1)}, with w_j(P)=q^{j-1-k_{j-1}} on nullity jumps and q^j-q^{j-1-k_{j-1}} otherwise; Z_n(q)=Phi_{n,q}(q). For algebraically closed K, dim{(A,B) in T_n(K)^2:AB=0}=n(n+1)/2+floor(n^2/4), with one top-dimensional irreducible component for even n and two for odd n.
